notes: All CLI items are client-side (cli_only=true): `docker compose` composes Engine API calls selected by com.docker.compose.* labels; summaries name the calls.

The provider pins compose-go v2.16.2. Its embedded schema (upstream/compose-spec/compose-go-embedded.json) differs from compose-spec main only in: container_spec mem_limit, memswap_limit, shm_size typed number|string (spec: integer|string), and no jobs.*.extends (Compose NEXT). It already has jobs, models, include, schedule.
Spec items handled by docker_compose use name docker_compose (kind resource) rather than inventing per-element types; splitting is a naming question.
docker_compose silently ignores top-level jobs (no warning) and warns on models; worth a TODO even without new types.
docker_stack is HCL-native (service blocks), not compose-file driven; docker_compose mode=swarm is the compose-file path to a stack. tools/compose2stack is a one-shot converter, not a Terraform type.
compose_convert has only a yaml (no .md) in compose-cli v5.1.4 docs; it is an alias of config. docker_compose.yaml is the root command.
climap compose rows: up, down, ps, up --scale -> docker_compose; exec -> docker_exec; logs -> docker_logs; pull -> docker_image; config/convert -> tools/compose2stack; build, run/watch/alpha -> none.
naming_questions: Imperative compose actions beside the docker_compose resource: name them docker_compose_up/down (CLI-shaped), docker_compose_apply/destroy, or skip up/down since the resource covers them?

`compose config` render: data source docker_compose_config (visually collides with docker_config and top-level `configs`), docker_compose_project / docker_compose_model, or a provider function compose_render?
`compose ps` / `compose ls`: docker_compose_ps + docker_compose_ls (CLI names) or docker_compose_containers + docker_compose_projects (noun convention like docker_containers)?
`compose volumes`: add a docker_compose_volumes data source, or document data.docker_volume/list.docker_volume with a project label filter (avoids the docker_volume clash)?
Per-container verbs (start/stop/restart/kill/pause/unpause): separate docker_compose_* actions, or one set of docker_container_* actions with an optional project/service selector?
`compose scale` vs existing docker_service_scale: new docker_compose_scale action, or extend docker_service_scale to compose local projects?
Compose top-level elements: keep all inside docker_compose, or split docker_compose_service/network/volume (confusable with docker_service/docker_network/docker_volume)?
jobs: support in docker_compose (run once on apply) plus docker_compose_run for manual triggers, or leave unsupported but add a warning?

items.name: docker_compose
items.summary: services: long-running containers (local) or Swarm services (swarm), managed as part of the docker_compose project.
items.status_note: docker_compose loads services with compose-go and creates containers (local) or Swarm services (swarm). Ignored with a warning: build (no image is an error, pull_policy build errors), develop, pre_start/post_start/pre_stop hooks, models, provider, credential_spec, blkio_config, use_api_socket, external_links, attach (local); swarm mode also ignores container_name, depends_on, network_mode, privileged, devices, ipc/pid/userns/uts/cgroup_parent, security_opt, shm_size, volumes_from, gpus, links, tmpfs, pull_policy other than missing/always.
items.collision: A per-service type named docker_compose_service would be confusable with docker_service (swarm). Keep services inside docker_compose.

items.name: docker_compose
items.summary: networks: project networks created and labelled by docker_compose (bridge locally, overlay in swarm); external networks are referenced only.
items.collision: docker_compose_network would be confusable with docker_network.

items.name: docker_compose
items.summary: volumes: named project volumes created by docker_compose (removed on destroy unless keep_volumes); external volumes referenced only.
items.collision: docker_compose_volume(s) would be confusable with docker_volume and with the proposed docker_compose_volumes data source (CLI `compose volumes`).

items.name: docker_compose
items.summary: configs: file/environment/content-sourced config objects; copied into containers locally, created as Swarm configs in swarm mode.
items.status_note: Local mode copies the content into the container (no bind mount); swarm mode creates Swarm configs but ignores driver and template_driver with a warning.
items.collision: Top-level `configs` vs docker_config (Swarm config resource) vs the proposed docker_compose_config data source (CLI `compose config`, rendered model).

items.name: docker_compose
items.summary: secrets: file/environment-sourced secrets; copied to /run/secrets locally, created as Swarm secrets in swarm mode.
items.status_note: Local mode copies content into the container (no bind mount as compose does); swarm mode ignores driver and template_driver with a warning.
items.collision: docker_compose_secret would be confusable with docker_secret.

items.name: docker_compose
items.summary: models: AI models (Docker Model Runner) that services bind to via endpoint/model env vars.
items.status_note: Parsed by compose-go but ignored: service `models` gets a warning in local mode; the top-level element is never acted on. Model Runner is not part of the Docker Engine API, so support needs a separate client.

items.name: docker_compose
items.summary: jobs: run-to-completion containers with manual or scheduled triggers (Compose NEXT).
items.status_note: compose-go v2.16.2 parses jobs (Project.Jobs) but docker_compose never reads them: silently ignored, not even warned. Scheduled triggers need a scheduler outside Terraform; manual runs map to the proposed docker_compose_run action. The embedded compose-go schema lacks jobs.*.extends.

items.name: docker_compose
items.summary: include: pull other compose files (with own project_directory/env_file) into the model.
items.status_note: Local-path includes are resolved by the compose-go loader; remote (git/oci) includes are disabled by design (compose_parse.go).

items.name: docker_compose
items.summary: name: project name used to prefix and label every object.
items.status_note: docker_compose.project_name defaults to the file's top-level name.

items.summary: version: obsolete top-level element, informational only.
items.skip_reason: obsolete; Compose ignores it (warns) and so does the loader

items.name: docker_image
items.summary: service.build: build the service image (context, dockerfile, args, secrets, cache, platforms...).
items.status_note: docker_compose does not build (warns; errors when image is unset); docker_image covers the build as a separate resource. A build action would be docker_compose_build.

items.name: docker_service
items.summary: service.deploy: replicas, mode, resources, restart/update/rollback policy, placement, labels.
items.status_note: docker_compose swarm mode maps deploy to the Swarm service spec; local mode uses replicas (scale), global mode and resources. Not its own Terraform type: it is the docker_service spec.

items.summary: service.develop: watch rules (sync/rebuild/restart) used by `compose watch`.
items.skip_reason: developer inner-loop file watching; not declarative (docker_compose warns and ignores it)

items.summary: fragments: compose file-format mechanic (YAML anchors/aliases).
items.skip_reason: file-format mechanic, handled by the compose loader

items.summary: extensions: compose file-format mechanic (x-* keys; ignored by docker_compose).
items.skip_reason: file-format mechanic, handled by the compose loader

items.summary: interpolation: compose file-format mechanic (fed by docker_compose env / env_file and the compose_env function).
items.skip_reason: file-format mechanic, handled by the compose loader

items.summary: merge: compose file-format mechanic (docker_compose.files merges in order like repeated -f).
items.skip_reason: file-format mechanic, handled by the compose loader

items.summary: profiles: compose file-format mechanic (docker_compose.profiles selects them).
items.skip_reason: file-format mechanic, handled by the compose loader

items.summary: Root `docker compose` command group.
items.skip_reason: command group only; global flags (-f, -p, --profile, --env-file) are docker_compose attributes

items.name: docker_compose_up
items.summary: Create/recreate and start the project. Engine: network/volume create, image pull, container create/start (+ wait).
items.status_note: The docker_compose resource does up on create/update; climap maps `compose up` to it. A standalone action would serve projects not managed by Terraform.
items.collision: docker_compose (resource) already means up; an action docker_compose_up beside it invites confusion.

items.name: docker_compose_down
items.summary: Stop and remove the project's containers and networks (optionally volumes, images). Engine: container stop/delete, network delete, volume delete.
items.status_note: Destroying docker_compose (keep_volumes) is down; no action for projects outside Terraform.

items.name: docker_compose_start
items.summary: Start existing service containers, selected by project/service labels. Engine: GET /containers/json (label filter) + POST /containers/{id}/start.
items.collision: Would mirror single-container docker_container_start actions if the engine lane proposes them; decide separate compose types vs a project/service selector on those.

items.summary: Create service containers without starting them.
items.skip_reason: half of `up`; the docker_compose resource owns container creation

items.summary: Remove stopped service containers.
items.skip_reason: docker_compose reconciles and removes its own containers; one-off cleanup is docker_system_prune

items.name: docker_compose_build
items.summary: Build every service with a `build:` section. Engine: POST /build or BuildKit session.
items.status_note: docker_compose ignores build: and climap says no equivalent; docker_image builds one image per resource.

items.name: docker_compose_pull
items.summary: Pull all service images. Engine: POST /images/create.
items.status_note: docker_compose pulls missing images during apply; climap maps it to docker_image.

items.name: docker_compose_push
items.summary: Push all service images. Engine: POST /images/{name}/push.
items.status_note: docker_registry_image pushes one image per resource; no project-wide push.

items.name: docker_compose_run
items.summary: Run a one-off container for a service or job. Engine: container create/start/wait/delete.
items.status_note: climap: no equivalent. Also the natural manual trigger for compose `jobs`.

items.name: docker_compose_exec
items.summary: Exec a command in a service container. Engine: POST /containers/{id}/exec + /exec/{id}/start.
items.status_note: climap maps it to docker_exec with the <project>-<service>-<n> container name; no service selector.

items.name: docker_compose_cp
items.summary: Copy files between a service container and the local filesystem. Engine: PUT/GET /containers/{id}/archive.
items.status_note: docker_container has upload blocks for containers it manages; nothing for compose containers or for copying out.

items.name: docker_compose_commit
items.summary: Create an image from a service container. Engine: POST /commit.

items.name: docker_compose_export
items.summary: Export a service container filesystem as a tar. Engine: GET /containers/{id}/export.
items.status_note: docker_container_export takes a container, not a project/service.

items.name: docker_compose_scale
items.summary: Set the replica count of services. Engine: container create/start/stop/delete (local).
items.status_note: Declaratively via deploy.replicas in docker_compose content; docker_service_scale covers swarm services.
items.collision: docker_service_scale (swarm action) already exists; docker_compose_scale is near-identical in purpose.

items.name: docker_compose_wait
items.summary: Block until service containers stop. Engine: POST /containers/{id}/wait.
items.status_note: docker_compose has wait/wait_timeout for readiness after apply, not for exit.

items.name: docker_compose_publish
items.summary: Publish the compose application as an OCI artifact to a registry.
items.status_note: Registry (OCI distribution) API, not Engine API.

items.name: docker_compose_containers
items.summary: List containers of a project. Engine: GET /containers/json with com.docker.compose.project label filter.
items.status_note: docker_compose.services gives container IDs for managed projects; docker_containers can filter by label for others.
items.collision: Name options: docker_compose_ps (CLI-shaped) vs docker_compose_containers (plural-noun convention beside docker_containers).

items.name: docker_compose_projects
items.summary: List compose projects on the host. Engine: GET /containers/json grouped by project label.

items.name: docker_compose_config
items.summary: Parse, interpolate, merge and render the compose model in canonical form (no Engine call).
items.status_note: tools/compose2stack converts once at authoring time (a tool, not a type); compose_env only builds env. No type renders the model.
items.collision: Confusable with top-level compose `configs` and docker_config (swarm config resource). Alternatives: docker_compose_project, docker_compose_model, or function compose_render.

items.summary: List images used by project containers. Engine: GET /containers/json + /images/{id}/json.

items.name: docker_compose_volumes
items.summary: List volumes of a project. Engine: GET /volumes with project label filter.
items.status_note: docker_compose.volumes lists managed project volumes; no lookup for others.

items.name: docker_compose_logs
items.summary: Read logs of service containers. Engine: GET /containers/{id}/logs.
items.status_note: climap maps it to docker_logs per container; no project/service selector.

items.name: docker_compose_top
